verdict.rationale: Firebase offers Gemini in Firebase, a natural-language chat interface for querying Firebase products, generating code, and troubleshooting, plus an official MCP server that lets AI agents/editors manage Firebase projects, auth, Firestore data, and messaging via natural-language-driven tool calls. This gives AI-native users real natural-language operation, but it's mediated through Gemini/MCP-client tools rather than a built-in universal NL command interface across the whole product, and there's no independent hands-on evidence of reliability. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of natural-language command accuracy, evidence of NL coverage beyond the specific MCP-listed operations (e.g., full admin/billing operations), and confirmation this works without third-party AI tool integration.
